enrichment.core_claim: High-density EEG from 300 meditation sessions across traditions shows deeper meditative states converge on shared, more stable large-scale brain dynamics.
enrichment.ask_question: Which EEG signature best tracked the move from mind-wandering into deep absorption across all the traditions you recorded?
enrichment.challenge_question: How do you separate genuine state signatures from differences in posture, eye movement, or expectation between expert and novice meditators?
